primary_anatomy_cohort: 36 completed frames, 30 visible frames, 50 human ellipses
matching: Highest-confidence nose box; unordered one-to-one keypoints inside human ellipse
location_screen: Candidate correct points must strictly exceed baseline, precision must not decrease, and visible frames with no box must not increase
screen_limit: A pass only supports further retrospective evaluation, never automatic deployment or an RR improvement claim
source_validation_limit: Old frozen model may have seen source validation videos; only candidate uses the new grouped split
